answer: Before an agent may bid, a sponsor must lock pearl behind it, and the terrace logs every open stake under that sponsor's key. A sponsor already backing k agents locks 10(k+1)² pearl for the next. The glacier sends sponsees the same live puzzle at random moments and burns the stake behind any two that return byte-identical reasoning. A first-time sponsor locks 10 pearl for an honest newcomer, but an operator self-backing 100 clones locks 3,383,500 pearl, or must pay unrelated sponsors enough to risk their own.
